message.content:
Sync the storefront widget CSS in `extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid` to match the admin preview CSS in `app/routes/app.widget.tsx`. The admin preview is the source of truth for the new design.

Read BOTH files first, then update the storefront.

## CSS changes needed in `buildWidgetCss()` function (around line 357-383 in zip-code-checker.liquid):

### 1. Search bar — change from 10px rounded to 50px pill
Find: `border-radius:10px`
Change to: `border-radius:50px`
Also change: `background:#fff` → `background:#f8f9fa`
Also change: `border:1.5px solid #e5e7eb` → `border:1px solid #e8e8e8`
Also change focus: `{p}18` → `{p}15`

### 2. Input — adjust padding
Find: `padding:13px 16px`
Change to: `padding:12px 16px`

### 3. Button — pill-right with uppercase + shadow
Find the `.zcc-btn` line and replace entirely with:
```
W + " .zcc-btn{background:" + cfg.primaryColor + " !important;color:#fff !important;border:none !important;padding:12px 22px !important;font-size:13px !important;font-weight:700 !important;text-transform:uppercase !important;letter-spacing:0.5px !important;cursor:pointer !important;white-space:nowrap !important;flex-shrink:0 !important;border-radius:0 50px 50px 0 !important;box-shadow:0 2px 8px " + cfg.primaryColor + "25 !important;transition:transform 0.2s ease,box-shadow 0.2s ease,filter 0.2s !important}" +
```

### 4. Button hover — add transform lift
Find: `W + " .zcc-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.08) !important}"`
Change to: `W + " .zcc-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px) !important;box-shadow:0 4px 14px " + cfg.primaryColor + "40 !important;filter:brightness(1.06) !important}"`

### 5. Button active — add transform reset
Find: `W + " .zcc-btn:active{filter:brightness(0.95) !important}"`
Change to: `W + " .zcc-btn:active{transform:translateY(0) !important;filter:brightness(0.95) !important}"`

### 6. Button disabled — reset transform
Find: `W + " .zcc-btn:disabled{opacity:.6 !important;cursor:not-allowed !important;filter:none !important}"`
Change to: `W + " .zcc-btn:disabled{opacity:.6 !important;cursor:not-allowed !important;transform:none !important;box-shadow:none !important;filter:none !important}"`

### 7. Heading — bolder, smaller, with bottom border
Find the `.zcc-heading` line and replace with:
```
W + " .zcc-heading{font-size:15px !important;font-weight:700 !important;letter-spacing:-0.01em !important;margin:0 !important;color:" + cfg.textColor + " !important;display:flex !important;align-items:center !important;gap:8px !important;padding-bottom:12px !important;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06) !important;margin-bottom:12px !important}" +
```

### 8. Heading icon — gradient background
Find: `background:" + cfg.primaryColor + "15 !important`
Change to: `background:linear-gradient(135deg," + cfg.primaryColor + "18," + cfg.primaryColor + "08) !important`

### 9. Heading icon SVG — match admin size
Find: `width:15px !important;height:15px !important` (in `.zcc-heading-icon svg`)
Change to: `width:14px !important;height:14px !important`

### 10. Result card — full border instead of left-border, spring animation
Find the `.zcc-result` line and replace with:
```
W + " .zcc-result{margin-top:10px !important;padding:12px 14px !important;border-radius:12px !important;font-size:13.5px !important;line-height:1.5 !important;animation:zcc-slide-in 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) !important;display:flex !important;gap:10px !important;align-items:flex-start !important;justify-content:space-between !important}" +
```

### 11. Result ok/fail — full border, no left-border
Find: `W + " .zcc-result.ok{background:" + cfg.successColor + "0c !important;border-left-color:" + cfg.successColor + " !important;color:" + cfg.successColor + " !important}"`
Change to: `W + " .zcc-result.ok{background:" + cfg.successColor + "08 !important;border:1px solid " + cfg.successColor + "18 !important}"`

Find: `W + " .zcc-result.fail{background:" + cfg.errorColor + "0c !important;border-left-color:" + cfg.errorColor + " !important;color:" + cfg.errorColor + " !important}"`
Change to: `W + " .zcc-result.fail{background:" + cfg.errorColor + "08 !important;border:1px solid " + cfg.errorColor + "18 !important}"`

### 12. Waitlist — gradient bg, rounded, pill button
Find: `W + " .zcc-wl{margin-top:12px...` line and replace:
```
W + " .zcc-wl{margin-top:10px !important;padding:14px !important;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f8fafc,#f1f5f9) !important;border-radius:12px !important;border:1px solid #e2e8f0 !important}" +
```

Find: `W + " .zcc-wl-input{border-radius:8px...` and change `margin-bottom:8px` to `margin-bottom:6px`

Find: `W + " .zcc-wl-btn{border-radius:8px...` and change `border-radius:8px` to `border-radius:50px`, `padding:11px` to `padding:10px`

### 13. Animation keyframe — spring easing
Find: `@keyframes zcc-slide-in{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}`
Change to: `@keyframes zcc-slide-in{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}`

### 14. Mobile responsive — update button radius to match pill
Find in @media: `W + " .zcc-btn{border-radius:0 0 8px 8px !important}"`
Change to: `W + " .zcc-btn{border-radius:0 0 50px 50px !important}"`

## CSS changes needed in `buildSharedCss()` function (around line 332-353):

### 15. Meta rows — tighter spacing, emoji support
Find the `.zcc-meta` line and replace:
```
W + " .zcc-meta{margin-top:4px !important;font-size:13px !important;display:flex !important;align-items:center !important;gap:6px !important;color:" + cfg.textColor + " !important;line-height:1.3 !important}" +
W + " .zcc-meta .zcc-emoji{font-size:14px !important;flex-shrink:0 !important;width:18px !important;text-align:center !important}" +
W + " .zcc-meta strong{font-weight:700 !important}" +
```

### 16. COD — pill badge styling
Find the `.zcc-cod` line and replace:
```
W + " .zcc-cod{margin-top:6px !important;display:inline-flex !important;align-items:center !important;gap:5px !important;border-radius:20px !important;padding:3px 10px !important;font-size:12px !important;font-weight:600 !important}" +
W + " .zcc-cod--available{background:" + cfg.successColor + "10 !important;border:1px solid " + cfg.successColor + "20 !important;color:" + cfg.successColor + " !important}" +
W + " .zcc-cod--unavailable{background:#d72c0d10 !important;border:1px solid #d72c0d20 !important;color:#d72c0d !important}" +
```

### 17. Add wl-title and wl-btn hover transform
Add after the `.zcc-wl-btn:disabled` line:
```
W + " .zcc-wl-title{font-size:13px !important;font-weight:700 !important;color:" + cfg.textColor + " !important;margin-bottom:10px !important}" +
W + " .zcc-wl-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.06) !important;transform:translateY(-1px) !important}" +
```
Wait — `.zcc-wl-btn:hover` already exists. Replace the existing one:
Find: `W + " .zcc-wl-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.08) !important}"`
Change to: `W + " .zcc-wl-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.06) !important;transform:translateY(-1px) !important}"`

Also add the `.zcc-wl-title` line and `.zcc-wl-input:focus` line. Check if `.zcc-wl-input:focus` already exists in shared CSS — yes it does. Keep it.

Add `.zcc-wl-title` somewhere in the buildSharedCss return, e.g. before the social-proof line:
```
W + " .zcc-wl-title{font-size:13px !important;font-weight:700 !important;color:" + cfg.textColor + " !important;margin-bottom:10px !important}" +
```

## IMPORTANT:
- Keep ALL `!important` flags (storefront needs them to override theme CSS)
- Don't change any HTML structure or JavaScript logic — only CSS
- Don't touch the Liquid template code outside the JavaScript
- After all edits, verify the file is syntactically valid JavaScript (no broken strings)
